unresolved.name: contact
unresolved.reason: templates/page.contact.liquid has no owning page record: sitemap_pages_1.xml lists only chinh-sach-bao-mat, about-us, dieu-khoan-dich-vu, frontpage, chinh-sach-doi-tra and lien-he, and /pages/contact returns HTTP 404. The copy theme 1001512581 does not contain the template: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=1001512581&view=contact silently falls back to page.liquid (identical body to /pages/lien-he, none of the template's markers such as 'Always Ready To Be Different' appear). The live theme does render it: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=-1&view=contact was requested and the marker is present. Capturable only after the copy is synced.

unresolved.name: wishlist
unresolved.reason: templates/page.wishlist.liquid has no owning page record (/pages/wishlist returns HTTP 404 and sitemap_pages_1.xml has no 'wishlist' entry). https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=-1&view=wishlist was requested and returned a full-page render carrying the theme layout, but take-effect is not text-verifiable: the template contains no static visible text (every string is injected by its own script), so it cannot be distinguished from a page.liquid fallback by content. Reachability therefore stays unverified.

unresolved.name: member
unresolved.reason: templates/customers[account].member.liquid is auth-gated. Both https://phukienmaymoc.com/account?themeid=1001512581 and https://phukienmaymoc.com/account?themeid=1001512581&view=member resolve to https://phukienmaymoc.com/auth/200001207485/sign-in?urlredirect=... (Haravan hosted sign-in, title 'Haravan - Checkouts'), so the account view cannot be captured anonymously. The sibling customers[*] templates belong to the /account/login, /account/register, /account/addresses and /account/orders routes and are gated the same way.
